title: Ultrasound-Based Prediction of Cirrhosis Decompensation Using Large-Scale Computer Vision Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.04365v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decompensation represents a critical transition in the course of cirrhosis, yet clinicians have limited non-invasive tools to reliably predict its onset. In this study, we propose a novel imaging-based approach that leverages large-scale computer vision models to analyze routine abdominal ultrasound images and extract predictive features beyond those captured by traditional laboratory-based risk scores. Ultrasound is widely available, low cost, and suitable for longitudinal surveillance, making it an attractive modality for scalable risk stratification and long-term follow-up. Our framework integrates automated ultrasound data processing with modern deep learning architectures to identify patients at high risk of decompensation prior to the occurrence of clinical deterioration. translated_title: 基于超声波与大规模计算机视觉模型的肝硬化失代偿预测
translated_abstract: 失代偿是肝硬化病程中的一个关键转折点，然而临床医生可用的无创工具有限，难以可靠地预测其发生。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于影像的方法，利用大规模计算机视觉模型分析常规腹部超声图像，提取传统基于实验室检查的风险评分所无法捕捉的预测性特征。超声检查应用广泛、成本低廉，且适合纵向监测，使其成为可扩展的风险分层和长期随访的理想模态。我们的框架将自动化的超声数据处理与现代深度学习架构相结合，在临床恶化发生之前识别出失代偿高风险患者。这种无创策略为现有临床评分系统提供了实用的补充，并有望实现对肝硬化患者更早、更主动的管理。
tldr: 该研究提出利用大规模计算机视觉模型分析常规腹部超声图像，在临床恶化发生之前无创预测肝硬化失代偿风险，为现有临床评分系统提供了实用的补充。
en_tdlr: This study proposes leveraging large-scale computer vision models to analyze routine abdominal ultrasound images for non-invasive prediction of cirrhosis decompensation before clinical deterioration, offering a practical complement to existing clinical scoring systems.
